result.name: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 Path Traversal and RCE Vulnerability (CVE-2021-41773)

nvt.solution: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to version 2.4.51 or later and ensure Require all denied is set on root directory.

result.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 allows an attacker to use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the directories configured by Alias-like directives, leading to Remote Code Execution when mod_cgi is enabled.

result.name: Apache Tomcat AJP Ghostcat File Read / Inclusion (CVE-2020-1938)

nvt.solution: Upgrade Apache Tomcat to 9.0.31 or later, disable AJP connector if unused, or configure requiredSecret attribute.

result.description: Apache Tomcat 9.0.30 processes untrusted AJP requests and exposes sensitive configuration files and web application deployment descriptors.

result.name: Redis Unauthenticated Configuration & Lua Sandbox Escape (CVE-2022-0543)

nvt.solution: Bind Redis to 127.0.0.1, enable requirepass / ACL authentication, and apply Debian upstream security updates.

result.description: Redis 6.0.15 instance listening on 0.0.0.0:6379 accepts unauthenticated CONFIG GET commands and is vulnerable to Lua package escaping.

result.name: MySQL Server 8.0.27 Optimizer Privilege Escalation / DoS (CVE-2022-21245)

nvt.solution: Upgrade Oracle MySQL Server to 8.0.28 or later and restrict network access strictly to application tier security groups.

result.description: Vulnerability in the MySQL Server product of Oracle MySQL (component: Server: Security: Privileges). Easily exploitable vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Server.
